scenarios.prompt: A rollback match predicts remote input for six ticks, then receives a correction that invalidates a visible hit. Define snapshot contents, rewind/resimulation and predicted-versus-confirmed presentation handling.

criteria.determinism: Rollback snapshots include all deterministic state including RNG streams and logical spawned state.
criteria.prediction: Predicted and confirmed events have explicit reconciliation and stable IDs; visible predictions may be revoked.
criteria.evidence: Captured packet/input traces test latency/jitter/loss, resimulation hashes and duplicate presentation suppression.
